steps.check: 教學三個誤差量為 10、8、5 μm，分別以界限與標準差兩種假設計算。；將上述數值全部標為教學假設，並在界面圖上逐一找到對應量測位置；產品事實另以來源頁核對。
steps.checkEn: Teaching terms are 10, 8 and 5 μm, considered under two separate assumptions: bounds or standard deviations.; Label all these values as teaching assumptions and locate their measurement points on the interface drawing; verify product facts separately against the source.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: NIST 的工具機校準研究涵蓋幾何、熱、負載與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: NIST machine-tool calibration research addresses geometry, thermal effects, load and uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 比較最壞相加與獨立隨機 RSS，正確選擇驗收依據。
knowledge.textEn: Compare worst-case addition with independent-random RSS and choose the proper acceptance basis.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 上界最壞和 B=Σbi；獨立零均值標準差 σ=sqrt(Σσi²)，兩者意義不同。；不能用同一組數值同時宣稱兩種統計意義，更不能用 1σ 當絕對界限。
knowledge.textEn: Worst-case bound B=Σbi differs from independent zero-mean σ=sqrt(Σσi²).; The same numbers cannot simultaneously carry both meanings, and 1σ is not an absolute bound.

stages.title: 案例界面與資料可信度
stages.description: NIST 的工具機校準研究涵蓋幾何、熱、負載與不確定度。；把位置鏈拆成編碼器、幾何與夾具三項，每項標上界或標準差，禁止混算。
stages.descriptionEn: NIST machine-tool calibration research addresses geometry, thermal effects, load and uncertainty.; Split the position chain into encoder, geometry and fixture terms, labeling each as a bound or standard deviation.
